title: Eight-FE-model range of lumbar facet joint forces under 7.5 Nm pure moments (Dreischarf 2014)

quantity.name: facet joint force (FE model predictions)
quantity.definition: each model's median facet joint force over levels L1-L5; FE median = median of the model medians, range = min-max of model medians (dotted bar). Extension: mean of left and right; LB and AR: the more loaded side. NOT experimental data.

source.authors: Dreischarf M, Zander T, Shirazi-Adl A, Puttlitz CM, Adam CJ, Chen CS, Goel VK, Kiapour A, Kim YH, Labus KM, Little JP, Park WM, Wang YH, Wilke HJ, Rohlmann A, Schmidt H
source.sample: 8 FE models (not specimens); eight published L1-L5 FE models (anonymised Models 1-8)

protocol.summary: Pure moments 7.5 Nm, no preload; L5 fixed.
how_to_simulate: Fix L5, apply 7.5 Nm pure moments to L1
Extract facet contact force at every level; extension: average left/right; LB/AR: higher-loaded side
protocol.notes: Text: segmental FJF on average 0 N flexion, 32 N extension, 12 N lateral bending, 87 N axial rotation; in extension and AR two of seven models predict FJF well outside the in vitro range. Digitised per-model medians (N, +/-3): extension M1 19, M2 16, M3 30, M4 107, M5 9, M6 35, M7 108, M8 50; AR M1 72, M2 38, M3 63, M4 115, M5 90, M6 86, M7 134, M8 89; LB M2 32, M4 42, M7 19, M8 26, M1/M3/M5/M6 below ~5 (not resolvable). Per-model whiskers (min-max across levels) not extracted. Figures in the QUT eprints author version are low-resolution embedded bitmaps (~550x420 px for a 4-panel figure); digitised by pixel analysis of the extracted image against gridlines.

data.note: text: 0 N on average; some models up to ~25 N at single levels

extraction.uncertainty: +/-3 N for ranges; medians from text
extraction.check_notes: Digitised FE-median bars 32.4 (ext) and 86.2 (AR) vs text 32 and 87. Median of digitised model medians reproduces text (ext 32.5, AR 87.5, LB ~11.5). FE-median whisker tops (108, 134) equal the highest model medians, confirming range = range of model medians. | verified 2026-11-12 independent check: OK (Section 3.2 text 0/32/12/87 N; Fig 2c model-bar extremes ext 9-108, AR 38-134, LB max 42)

pass_rule.rule: PASS = inside in vitro range (Wilson 2006) AND inside model range; MARGINAL = one
